learning_outcomes.text: Explain responsible-AI risks for generative applications
Configure Bedrock Guardrails for content, topics and sensitive data
Detect and redact personally identifiable information
Reduce hallucination risk with grounding and contextual checks
Monitor, log and govern responsible-AI operations

integrative_case: Add a responsible-AI layer to a public-facing Bedrock assistant: define denied topics and content filters, redact PII in inputs and outputs, add contextual grounding checks, test the guardrail against a red-team set, and set up logging and governance for ongoing review.
